title: Implement Request Logging with Error Handling
description: This feature adds request logging to improve debugging and error tracking, it will log each incoming request and any errors that occur during processing, providing valuable insights for development and production environments. The logging will include request method, URL, and response status code. This will help identify and fix issues more efficiently
testCases: Test logging for requests with errors
acceptance: Request logging is successfully implemented and error handling is properly configured, with logs including request method, URL, and response status code
reason: Improved debugging and error tracking capabilities will enhance the overall quality and reliability of the yantraverse framework
